Part 1 |enva=Josh Ruben |java=Shinnosuke Tachibana |}} '''Lewis''' (Japanese: '''ユウト''' ''Yūto'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|BW}}. He appeared during the [[forces of nature]] arc. ==History== In ''[[BW059|Stopping the Rage of Legends! Part 1]]'', {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} traveled to [[Milos Island]] in order to get some [[Revival Herb]]s and were told that Lewis was the one to see about it. He informed them, however, that the Revival Herb crops have been dried up lately. Also, the {{type|Grass}}s in the area, including his {{p|Lilligant}}, had fallen ill. He then told Ash and his friends the legend of {{p|Landorus}} stopping the rampaging {{p|Tornadus}} and {{p|Thundurus}} long ago. Lewis regularly took {{p|Gothorita}} to {{p|Landorus}}'s obelisk to pray for the Revival Herbs to grow and for the Grass-type Pokémon to get better. He was then shocked when {{p|Tornadus}} showed up while they were visiting the obelisk. When he discovered that Tornadus's and Thundurus's obelisks were destroyed, he worried that history would repeat itself and Milos Island would be destroyed by their fighting. Lewis later asked {{an|Iris}} to dress like a shrine maiden and pray in front of Landorus's obelisk with his Gothorita to help awaken him so that he could stop Tornadus and Thundurus like he did eons ago. In ''[[BW060|Stopping the Rage of Legends! Part 2]]'', when Landorus got injured from fighting Tornadus and Thundurus, Lewis gave Landorus his last Revival Herb, so that he had the strength to fight off their attacks. After Landorus succeeded in calming the two, Lewis thanked him for his help and was pleased when the [[Forces of nature|trio]] used their powers to regrow the Revival Herbs. He then gave Ash and his friends a bag full of them to bring back to [[Driftveil City]]. ==Pokémon== ===On hand=== {{TrainerPoké |main=no |trainer=Lewis |pkmn=Lilligant |gender=female |type1=grass |img=Lewis Lilligant.png |epnum=BW059 |epname=Stopping the Rage of Legends! When {{TRT}} tried to make off with the captured [[forces of nature]], it utilized all of its moves to help stop them. It also helped Lewis send the [[Revival Herb]] to the injured Landorus. Gothorita's known moves are {{m|Telekinesis}}, {{m|Psyshock}}, and {{m|Shadow Ball}}.}} ===Befriended=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Lewis |pkmn=Landorus |type1=Ground |type2=Flying |gender=male |img=Landorus anime.png |epnum=BW059 |epname=Stopping the Rage of Legends! Part 1 |vajp=Kenta Miyake |vaen=Marc Thompson |main=Forces of nature (anime) |main_section=Landorus |desc=In an ancient legend, it was said {{p|Landorus}} came to Milos Island to stop Tornadus and Thundurus from fighting, so when the two started battling again when their obelisks on the island were destroyed, Lewis knew the only way he could save Milos Island was to have Iris dress up like a shrine maiden from the past and have her summon Landorus alongside his {{p|Gothorita}}. This worked, and Landorus descended from the skies and attempted to stop the two titans from fighting. However, after Team Rocket's aborted attempt to capture the trio, Landorus was exhausted and was badly injured during the ensuing battle. Despite the fact it was his last Revival Herb, Lewis used it to revive Landorus and allow him to continue fighting. Eventually he managed to make Tornadus and Thundurus see that their fight was pointless and as thanks to Lewis, he fertilized the land, allowing the Revival Herbs to start growing again.
